Thai L
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam1 contribution

Worst experience ever. 최악.
Jun 2023 • Friends
Sống ở SG được 9 năm. kinh nghiệm tệ nhất tại Saigon. 
been in Saigon for 9 years now and it was my worst experience.
Don't know why trip advisor recommended this place.
호치민 9년 살았는데, 가본 식당 중 최악. 2023년 6월 말 방문했고, 저녁 시간으로 예약하고 갔는데, 메뉴 중 절반 이상이 재료 소진으로 주문 불가. 점심장사가 피크라고 함. 당일 오후에 예약하고 저녁에 간거였는데 그럼 예약 시 미리 말을 해줬어야 함. 가능한 메뉴에 대해 설명해달라 했더니, 귀찮으니 먹고 싶은거 골라보고 안되는 게 있으면 자기가 말해주겠다고 함(되는 메뉴가 없는데 뭘 자꾸 나보고 고르래...?). 예약 시 아기 동반 예약했는데 아기의자 따로 없음. 일반 식당이야 괜찮지만 미슐랭 가이드 추천 식당이고 나름 고급 식당인데 아기의자도 없음. 되는게 하나도 없는데 종업원은 시종일관 뚱해있음. 메뉴 중 라이스페이퍼에 직접 쌈싸먹는 메뉴가 있어서 물티슈 좀 달라했더니 없다고 함. 관리인한테 물어봐달라 그랬더니 비웃으면서 책상위에 없으면 없는거라고 거기에 뭐하러 확인하냐 함. 화장실 있으니 화장실 가서 손씻으라 함. 헛웃음이 남.
우여곡적 끝에 음식 나왔는데 똥배짱으로 장사하는 것 치고는 심지어 음식들 맛도 그저 그럼. 직원 교육 아예 안되어 있고, 서비스 마인드 일절 없음. 진짜 후기 같은거 잘 안쓰는데, 하나부터 열까지 마음에 드는게 없는 식당이라 너무 별로였여서 경험이라 후기 남김.

A Welcoming Experience
Sep 2019
Not the type of review you expect but I want to share my experience about this great place.
 I was walking near this restaurant when suddenly very, very heavy rain started. I did not have an umbrella so raced under the awning of this restaurant. The rain continued so I decided to sit on one of their comfortable chairs and wait till the rain eased. 
After 10 minutes it was still raining when a waiter came out to me and gave me a glass of tea. I said that I had not ordered anything then he told me it was compliments from the manager.
Wow, what a welcoming experience. I love how friendly the people of Vietnam are......he could have easily asked me to move away so I presume the food service is just as inviting.

reviews.review_text:
Staff61
Tennessee245 contributions

Best Meal In The City
Jun 2019 • Family
Had the pleasure of enjoying dinner with our family at Bep Nha Xu Quang and it was the best meal of our trip. 

For starters, we enjoyed chicken wings on sticky rice which was exceptional. Crispy skin yet tender meat complimented by the sticky rice. 

Our main course was a noodle dish that consisted of shrimp, pork and noodles in a well seasoned broth. One of the best dishes I’ve eaten while in Vietnam. 

To close, we had young tofu. Fried on the outside and very soft on the inside. Tasty and sweet

The staff here was on their A game. Service staff was prompt, attentive, and highly skilled 

Would suggest this restaurant when visiting Vietnam. Sure to be a highlight of any culinary adventure.

reviews.review_text:
Daisy
55 contributions
0
Poor quality food, poor staffs’ attitude
May 2019
I have had lunch here 2 times, 2 years ago at Hai Ba Trung, and I was happy then. That’s why I recommend my friends today to Bep Nha Xu Quang. But my good impression was totally ruined. 
We ordered young jackfruits mixed with shrimp and pork (gỏi mít non tôm thịt), mussels with rice paper (hến xúc bánh tráng), and tuna noodle (bún cá ngừ). The drink was aloe vera mixed with pandan. All of them were under average quality: the two mixed dishes were too oily, the pork was dry and not fresh, the mussels mix has a smell of fish. The tuna noodle was too sweet and the tuna was not match with the soup. My drink had not any of pandan flavour. 
Besides that, the staffs were cold, served like robots and although there were numerous of staffs, it was very difficult to call one. 
I was so disappointed that I invited my friends to a bad lunch. Never come back again.
